name: hangboard pull up
description: A pull-up done from the holds of a hangboard instead of a bar. It trains the fingers and the pulling muscles to work together, as they do on the wall.
instructions: Pick holds you can hang from comfortably, such as large edges or jugs to start.
Grip the holds with both hands in the grip you want to train, such as open hand or half crimp.
Hang with straight arms and your shoulders engaged.
Pull up until your chin reaches the bottom of the board, keeping the grip steady.
Lower yourself with control to straight arms.
End the set if your grip slips or changes shape.
Move to smaller holds or a harder grip only once the reps feel easy.
